title: Buy your first home
tagline: From 'can we afford it?' to the keys, with every party in one place.
trigger: Renting, steady salary, saving each month, and searching for property (search subscription, inspection, purchase deposit).

steps.title: What can we afford?
steps.description: KBC calculates a realistic budget from what it already knows, so you never fill in your income twice.
steps.why: Your income and savings are already at KBC: nothing needs to leave the bank.

win.customer: A realistic budget in one minute
win.kbc: Trusted early, months before the mortgage

steps.result: You can look at homes up to about €{budget_max_k}k and still keep €{buffer_k}k as a safety buffer.

steps.title: Find and value homes
steps.description: Immoscoop searches in your region and budget, and a local estate agent values the house you like.
steps.why: Vetted KBC partner with BIV-registered estate agents; it only sees your region and budget range.

win.customer: Only homes you can afford, with a fair price
win.kbc: Knows which house before the mortgage request

steps.result: 4 homes matched in {region}. The agent values your favourite, {property_address}, at €{price_k}k.

steps.title: Check the house before you bid
steps.description: EPC certificate and electrical inspection, so you know the energy label and the state of the house.
steps.why: Certified energy experts; it only needs the address.
steps.result: EPC label D (282 kWh/m²). Electrical installation compliant. Roof not insulated.

steps.title: Know the renovation bill and the grants
steps.description: Setle estimates what the renovation costs and which grants you can claim, before you make an offer.
steps.why: Specialised in renovation costs and grants; it sees the house, not you.

win.customer: Bid with the full cost in mind, grants included
win.kbc: Renovation financed in the same mortgage
win.partner: Paid report and a renovation lead

steps.result: Roof insulation, glazing and a heat pump: about €38,000, of which about €9,500 in grants. Label D → B.

steps.title: One loan for the house and the renovation
steps.description: Home loan and renovation loan in one file, pre-filled with the valuation and the renovation estimate.
steps.why: KBC already has your data and the partners' results: no documents to send.
steps.result: Offer ready: home and renovation loan of €{loan_k}k over 25 years. Approved in principle.

steps.title: Insured from the day you sign
steps.description: Home insurance and outstanding balance insurance start on the signing date, not a day later.
steps.why: KBC knows the signing date from the loan file, so there is no gap.
steps.result: Home insurance and outstanding balance insurance start on the signing date.

steps.title: All your papers in one place
steps.description: The deed, EPC, quotes and loan documents go into your digital vault. MyHome tracks what's next.
steps.why: Stored at KBC, only for you.
steps.result: Deed, EPC, inspection report and loan offer saved in your digital vault.
